title: Final velocity magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final numerical answer for the water's expulsion speed must be 28 m/s.

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the law of conservation of momentum to the isolated squid-water system.

title: Correct mass identification
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the squid's mass (1.4 kg) and the expelled water's mass (0.1 kg).

title: Initial system at rest
description: Important Criteria: The solution must state or use the condition that the total initial momentum of the system is zero.

title: Direction/sign consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the solution mishandles the signs of velocities (forward/backward) leading to an incorrect equation.

title: Unit inclusion
description: Optional Criteria: The final answer should include the correct unit (m/s).
